units.source_text: 三匹空马，另两匹上坐着姑娘。

en.t: Three horses were riderless, while girls were sitting on the other two.

units.source_text: 帐篷前并排着马儿，最右边一匹抬起低垂的头，离开队列，开始走动起来。

en.t: The horses were lined up in front of the tent, and the one on the far right lifted its drooping head, left the line, and began to walk.
A Guang also followed along and pulled on the reins.
